name: @synopackageland/sdk
description: Frontend SDK for DSM packages built with synopkgland: headless client and Vue components

scripts.prepack: test -d node_modules || { echo '@synopackageland/sdk: run npm ci before npm pack' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run build
scripts.build: node ../scripts/protocol-limits.mjs --check && node ../scripts/native-contract.mjs --check && node ../scripts/executor-manifest.mjs --check && vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R i18n dist/ && rm -rf spec && cp -R ../spec spec && cp -R ../api/nativehttp/schema spec/api/v3/schema
scripts.test:browser: node test/browser/picker-layout.mjs && node test/browser/shell-layout.mjs && node test/browser/shell-phone.mjs && node test/browser/portal-header.mjs && node test/browser/portal-phone.mjs && node test/browser/portal-phone-cycles.mjs && node test/browser/portal-name.mjs && node test/browser/entry-preload.mjs
